content.title: Monitoring & Management
content.content:
SnapLogic provides comprehensive monitoring and operational management capabilities:

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.20.06.png:Monitoring and Management Dashboard]

**Real-Time Dashboard**: Web-based dashboard showing Ground Plex health, active pipeline executions, error rates, and resource utilization

**Alerting**: Configurable alerts for pipeline failures, Ground Plex node failures, and performance degradation. Alerts via email, Slack, PagerDuty, or webhook

**Metrics Export**: Integration with Prometheus/Grafana for custom dashboards and long-term metric storage

**SNMP Trap Support**: Integration with enterprise monitoring tools (HP OpenView, IBM Tivoli, BMC Patrol)

**Syslog Export**: Centralized logging export to {{customer_name}} log aggregation platforms

**Performance Monitoring**:
- Pipeline execution duration trends
- Data throughput (records/second, MB/second)
- Resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk I/O per Ground Plex node)
- Connector response times (identify slow database queries or API calls)

**Capacity Planning**:
- Historical execution metrics for trend analysis
- Predictive alerts when approaching capacity limits
- Recommendations for Ground Plex node scaling

**Operational Dashboards**:
- Executive view: High-level pipeline success rates, data volumes processed
- Operations view: Active executions, error queue, scheduled pipeline status
- Developer view: Individual pipeline execution logs, Snap-level debugging
